paper_title: APT Improving Specialist LLM Performance with Weakness Case Acquisition   and Iterative Preference Training
caption: The exploration of hyperparameters.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the hyperparameter $\alpha$ and Accuracy(\%). The x-axis represents $\alpha$ on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 5, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The y-axis represents Accuracy(\%) on a linear scale, ranging from 22.75 to 23.75, with tick labels at intervals of 0.25. The plot features a single green line with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately (0, 22.8) and peaking at around (1, 23.7), then decreasing to approximately (5, 22.8).
